def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = grid[0][0]
    # Full separator rows and columns divide the grid into cells.
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]

    def segments(n, seps):
        bounds = [-1] + seps + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)
                if bounds[i] + 1 < bounds[i + 1]]

    row_segments = segments(h, row_seps)
    col_segments = segments(w, col_seps)
    special = 8 if sep == 0 else 2
    background = 4 if sep == 0 else 3

    return [
        [
            1 if sum(grid[r][c] == special
                     for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) >= 2
            else background
            for c0, c1 in col_segments
        ]
        for r0, r1 in row_segments
    ]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Separator color is the color forming complete rows and columns.
    colors = set(x for row in grid for x in row)
    sep = next(
        color for color in colors
        if any(all(x == color for x in row) for row in grid)
    )
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]

    def groups(size, separators):
        bounds = [-1] + separators + [size]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1])
                for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)
                if bounds[i] + 1 < bounds[i + 1]]

    rows = groups(h, row_seps)
    cols = groups(w, col_seps)

    marker = next(color for color in colors if color != sep and
                  sum(row.count(color) for row in grid) > 0)
    background = next(color for color in colors if color not in (sep, marker))

    return [
        [
            1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                     for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) >= 2
            else background
            for c0, c1 in cols
        ]
        for r0, r1 in rows
    ]
